meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary
meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Тебе ещё не надоела серая Москва?
examples.trans: Are you not tired of gray Moscow yet?

examples.text: Нам сейчас срочно надо идти на улицу.
examples.trans: We urgently need to go outside right now.

examples.text: Надо срочно бежать к Элеоноре!
examples.trans: I must urgently run to Eleonora!

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'was'.

examples.text: У меня есть машинка.
examples.trans: I have a toy car.

examples.text: Детство было трудное.
examples.trans: Childhood was hard.

examples.text: Ты будешь просить прощения.
examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'покойно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Ты правда так спокойно думаешь?
examples.trans: Do you really think so calmly?

examples.text: Да лети ты спокойно в свой Париж!
examples.trans: Just fly calmly to your Paris!

examples.text: Пойду лучше спокойно прогуляюсь на улице.
examples.trans: I will go take a quiet walk outside instead.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to take', paired with 'взять'.

examples.text: Ну давай сейчас попробуем разобраться!
examples.trans: Well let us try to settle this right now!

examples.text: Я ещё и собрать его должен сам?
examples.trans: Do I also have to assemble it myself?

examples.text: Добрый день, а я шкаф собрал.
examples.trans: Good afternoon, I assembled the wardrobe.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ловно').

examples.text: Честное слово, вот моё удостоверение.
examples.trans: Word of honor, here is my identification card.

examples.text: Словно в интересное кино сегодня сходила.
examples.trans: It is as if I went to an interesting movie today.

examples.text: За телевизор и за слова про маму.
examples.trans: For the television and for the words about mom.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('interesting').

examples.text: Словно в интересное кино сегодня сходила.
examples.trans: It is as if I went to an interesting movie today.

examples.text: Это очень интересная книга.
examples.trans: This is a very interesting book.

examples.text: Такая интересная!
examples.trans: Funny you should say that!

meanings.note: Common neuter noun meaning 'cinema, movies' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Словно в интересное кино сегодня сходила.
examples.trans: It is as if I went to an interesting movie today.

examples.text: Причём посмотрела кино совершенно бесплатно.
examples.trans: And watched the movie completely for free.

examples.text: Тогда пригласи меня в кино.
examples.trans: Then invite me to the movies.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'егодня').

examples.text: Кстати, сегодня вечером шкаф доставят.
examples.trans: By the way, they will deliver the wardrobe tonight.

examples.text: У неё сегодня сильный скачок давления.
examples.trans: She had a severe blood pressure spike today.

examples.text: Я хотел сегодня прощальный банкет устроить.
examples.trans: I wanted to throw a farewell banquet today.

meanings.en: to go and come back, to pop over
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ходить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to go (somewhere and come back)', paired with 'ходить'.

examples.text: А что тут вообще сейчас происходит?
examples.trans: And what on earth is going on here right now?

examples.text: Мне кто-нибудь объяснит, что происходит?
examples.trans: Will someone explain to me what is going on?

examples.text: Папа, объясни скорее, что тут происходит?
examples.trans: Dad, explain quickly, what is going on here?

причём.gloss: and that, what is more, moreover

meanings.en: and that, what is more, moreover, at that
meanings.note: High-frequency Russian clause-linking conjunction meaning 'and that, what is more, moreover', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Причём жили каждый сам по себе.
examples.trans: And each of you lived on your own.

examples.text: Причём посмотрела кино совершенно бесплатно.
examples.trans: And watched the movie completely for free.

examples.text: Это вкусная, причём полезная икра.
examples.trans: This is tasty, and what is more, healthy caviar.

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'смотреть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'looked', paired with 'смотреть'.

examples.text: Причём посмотрела кино совершенно бесплатно.
examples.trans: And watched the movie completely for free.

examples.text: Можно я посмотрю?
examples.trans: May I have a look?

examples.text: Я только посмотрел.
examples.trans: I only had a look.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'овершенно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Причём посмотрела кино совершенно бесплатно.
examples.trans: And watched the movie completely for free.

examples.text: Совершенно верно, я мэр этого города.
examples.trans: Quite right, I am the mayor of this town.

examples.text: Это совершенно новая машина.
examples.trans: This is a completely new car.

meanings.note: Privative prefix 'бес-' ('without, -less', before voiceless consonants) (stem 'платно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Причём посмотрела кино совершенно бесплатно.
examples.trans: And watched the movie completely for free.

examples.text: Если опоздают, пицца бесплатно.
examples.trans: If they're late, the pizza is free.

examples.text: Дети проходят бесплатно.
examples.trans: Children get in free.
